notes: Held-out tasks (round 2), written after v0.2's tuning and before any kopt measurement on them; not derived from bench/results/failures.md. Gold read in the code with git grep and sed only. Re-check with `kopt bench bench/tasks-heldout/laravel.json --verify`.

tasks.question: When a queued job fails and is released back onto the queue, how does the worker choose the delay before the next attempt?
tasks.search: queued job failed released delay next attempt backoff worker
tasks.verifiedBy: Read Queue\Worker: handleJobException releases the job with calculateBackoff($job, $options), which takes the job's backoff() (or the worker option), split on commas and indexed by attempts.

tasks.question: Where does Laravel verify a signed URL's signature and its expiration?
tasks.verifiedBy: Read Routing\UrlGenerator: hasValidSignature = hasCorrectSignature (HMAC of the URL without the signature query) && signatureHasNotExpired (expires query vs now).
